title: Switch opencode-cdc from rusqlite to Turso
description: Replace the current rusqlite-backed storage path in opencode-cdc with Turso-backed persistence. Use Turso directly and do not use libsql as the integration layer.
acceptance_criteria:
opencode-cdc no longer depends on or initializes rusqlite for its runtime storage path.
The replacement persistence path uses Turso directly, not libsql.
Database configuration, migrations/schema setup, and local development instructions are updated for Turso.
Existing CDC behavior is preserved or intentionally documented where the Turso switch changes semantics.
Tests or integration checks cover the Turso-backed path.
